name: Dictation
description: Speak where the cursor is (a note, the Ask box, a chat): ⌘J starts and ⌘J again stops, or hold ⌘J while you speak. Words show dimmed as you say them and settle into the text, recognized on this Mac: Apple's on-device recognizer, or Parakeet with Handy's or Hex's model. With nothing to type into, ⌘J opens the Ask box.

engine.label: Recognizer
engine.description: automatic: Parakeet when its model is on this Mac and the language is English, else Apple's (macOS 26). Parakeet is English only and uses the model Handy or Hex downloaded

language.label: Language
language.description: a language's code, like en or pt-BR, for Apple's recognizer; left out, the Mac's

silence.label: Stop after silence
silence.description: seconds without speech before a tapped dictation stops on its own; 0 never: it listens until you stop it

replacements.label: Replacements
replacements.description: what you say, then what's written, one a line ("at Claude: @claude"); the said words are also what the recognizer listens for

keep_audio.label: Keep the last dictation's audio
keep_audio.description: what the microphone heard last, kept on this Mac (the app's logs folder, dictation-last.wav) to replay it when a recognizer gets words wrong; each dictation replaces it
